content.value: . A coal sample has the following results:
(i) 0.5 g coal produces 1.35 g of CO₂ and 0.225 g of $\mathrm { H } _ { 2 } \mathrm { O } .$

(ii) 0.4 g coal liberates ammonia which was absorbed in 50 mL of 0.5N $\mathrm { H } _ { 2 } \mathrm { S O } _ { 4 } .$ The resultant solution required 22 mL of 1N NaOH solution for complete neutralization.
(iii) combustion of 0.5 g coal in bomb calorimeter by the treatment with BaCl₂ produces 0.06 g of BaSO₄.

Calculate the percentage of C, H, N, S and O by assuming ash content in the coal is 4.5%.   
Also find HCV and LCV.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
